title: Atlantic multi-decadal oscillation covaries with Agulhas leakage
subject: Ecology
question: According to the chart, what was the approximate value of heat transport via Agulhas leakage (solid black line) in 1965?

gold_answer.long_answer: In 1965, the solid black line representing heat transport via Agulhas leakage is at approximately 0.08 PW on the left y-axis.

original_caption:
The chart displays two time series from 1950 to approximately 2005, representing heat transport (left y-axis, in PW) and freshwater transport (right y-axis, in mSv, negative values indicating salt transport), both associated with Agulhas leakage and meridional transports in the South Atlantic.

- **Heat transport (black lines, left y-axis, 0.00–0.60 PW)**:
  - Solid black line: Heat transport via Agulhas leakage. It starts near 0.15 PW in 1950, dips to ~0.08 PW around 1965, then gradually rises
